gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ysabeau-infant: Horseshoe-wide curves, heavy diagonals: Cherry Swash walks in like it owns the room. Ysabeau Infant, a sans-serif with tong-like outward terminals, brings an approachable warmth that softens the heading's swagger.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ysabeau-office: Commanding and distinctive, Cherry Swash bends a horseshoe-wide c and weights its diagonals like its verticals. And Ysabeau Office does the quieter job, giving every curved letter an open-ended, modern finish.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC is professional and modern, with a visibly gaping c. Beneath the commanding single-weight lines of Cherry Swash, whole paragraphs of the sans text would read smoothly and without any fuss.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei reads modern and clean, its weight shifting softly. Below the commanding, compass-pencil lines of Cherry Swash, extended reading would move along gently, with no ink pooling at the turns.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-alpino: Comic Relief hits bold and commanding, with uniform strokes. Alpino, a cozy, casual sans-serif, tucks in underneath with tall, tightly spaced text and lets the heading do all the shouting.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-familjen-grotesk: Bold, commanding, bowls left open: that's Comic Relief at a glance. Familjen Grotesk follows with the same unfinished bowls and a taller, livelier lowercase, so heading and text feel related without being twins.
gen-gf-comic-relief-fs-hind: Comic Relief is bold and commanding, with strokes that never vary and bowls left unfinished on one side. Hind then settles in beneath it, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, steady as a drawn string.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans reads professional and modern, its curve tails held back. Comic Relief takes the top with bold, commanding strokes whose joins stay full width rather than thinning to hairlines.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Loud and commanding, Comic Relief leaves bowls unfinished on one side. Alegreya Sans SC, a modern sans-serif with a welcoming open gap in the c, gives that heading a friendly place to land.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-andika: Commanding up top, Comic Relief draws up and side strokes alike. Andika, with thick tails and wide, easy s turns, would carry a full page of reading without tiring the eye.
